tasks.title: Correct authoritative care timing and persisted resolution contracts
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh forward-only public-contract correction from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA without merging or cherry-picking the failed CONTRACT-CORR-001 Attempt. Remove caller-supplied acknowledgedAt and handledAt from AcknowledgeCareEvent and HandleCareEvent requests. Define Clock.now as the sole authoritative transition, deadline, persistence, idempotency, and audit time for those commands. Freeze acknowledgement as timely only when server now is strictly before the deadline; equality is already timed out. Add a bounded CareResolution to handled events, preserve it when a handled event closes, and add resolution to the content-free audit change-field contract. Include a non-user-selectable legacy_unknown persisted value for pre-correction handled or closed rows while rejecting it from new HandleCareEvent requests. Update examples and technical documentation without changing unrelated APIs, error codes, or product semantics.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA and no rejected Attempt SHA is an ancestor
Strict request schemas reject acknowledgedAt and handledAt supplied by callers
The public contract defines now before deadline as the only timely acknowledgement and treats equality as timed out
Handled events require one bounded resolution and closed events preserve any prior handling resolution
legacy_unknown is visible only for migrated history and cannot be selected by a new handling request
Audit changes can record only the bounded resolution enum and never free-form care content
Examples cover valid acknowledgement, handling, closure, invalid timestamps, missing resolution, and invalid resolution
The operation registry and every public schema example validate
No lockfile, unrelated command, query, privacy, handover, or UI contract changes

tasks.title: Replace private conversation and consented signal safety boundaries
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh conversation capability from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA without merging or cherry-picking CONV-001 or the rejected CONV-REPAIR-001 Attempt. Before any provider invocation, authorize the active actor, space, private message, evidence ownership and state, and same-speaker analysis consent. Detect every frozen high-risk category deterministically before provider invocation. Permit only bounded provider fields combined with human-authored templates, and apply the disclosure guard recursively to every provider-derived string, nested field, rendered draft, and shared signal. Compare private disclosure using Unicode Default Full Case Folding, including multi-code-point mappings, Unicode normalization, whitespace, punctuation, symbol, containment, and one-code-point edit normalization; lowercase alone is insufficient. ConfirmSignal must enter its transaction before reading authoritative Clock.now, lock and reread actor, consent, evidence, visibility, and versions, and revalidate immediately before persistence. Raw evidence and private messages remain self-only, and logs and errors remain content-free.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA and neither CONV-001 nor CONV-REPAIR-001 is an ancestor
Unauthorized, inactive, cross-space, missing, or mismatched source input fails before provider invocation and provider call count remains zero
Self-harm, domestic-violence, and acute-medical fixtures bypass the provider and create no ordinary task or automatic shared signal
Every provider-derived field, including nested and finally rendered values, is disclosure-checked and cannot publish private raw content

Exact and near-verbatim variants fail closed after Unicode Default Full Case Folding and normalization, including both directions of Straße family and STRASSE family, final sigma, canonical-equivalent, fullwidth, case, whitespace, punctuation, and one-code-point edits
Creating a private message produces no shared signal, task, report fact, confirmation record, or cross-role query result
Consent is per signal, belongs to the same speaker, and remains present, unexpired, and unrevoked through confirmation; a queued confirmation entering the transaction after expiry writes nothing
Raw-evidence and private-message queries remain self-only even when another role guesses an identifier
Consent revocation, evidence invalidation, actor deactivation, visibility drift, or version drift during provider execution or before persistence yields zero shared writes
Invalid output, timeout, provider failure, and a second invalid output return needs_human_review without consequential mutation
Logs and errors contain only identifiers and bounded outcome metadata

tasks.title: Replace responsibility attribution and neutral deterministic reporting
tasks.spec: Implement a fresh responsibility capability from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA without merging or cherry-picking RESP-001 or the rejected RESP-REPAIR-001 Attempt. Before provider invocation, validate the active requesting actor and every selected signal, provenance, evidence, and source member. Require signal, provenance, and persisted-evidence speaker identities to match; every source member must be active in the same space with analysisConsent enabled. Send only bounded redacted excerpts and provider-safe metadata; raw evidence and persistent entity identifiers must not cross the provider boundary. Revalidate the same guard after provider return. Confirmation may consume only an opaque server-issued, integrity-bound draft receipt whose persisted server-side content and current guard are verified; clients cannot submit mutable suggestion fields as authority. Resolve correction idempotency before mutable-state and no-op validation, generate audit identity and time only on a replay miss, and return the original content-free audit on replay. Derive reports deterministically from the five persisted stages, separate hidden coordination from execution, and use frozen neutral Chinese templates without an LLM.
acceptance: The task starts from the exact accepted FOUND-BASELOCK-001 SHA and neither RESP-001 nor RESP-REPAIR-001 is an ancestor
Unauthorized actor, space, task, signal, evidence, or non-exact selected sets fail before provider invocation
Revoked, inactive, or missing source members and any mismatch among signal, provenance, and evidence speaker identities leave provider and mutation counts at zero
Provider input contains no raw evidence, raw references, private content, or selected persistent entity identifiers
Timeout, provider error, and invalid first and second outputs return a bounded review state with zero attribution, report, or domain mutation
Actor or source consent, membership, visibility, evidence, review, or version drift during provider execution produces zero mutation
Unconfirmed, fabricated, failed-call, replayed, or field-tampered drafts cannot persist; only the exact server-issued draft confirmed by the same currently authorized human may persist
Exact correction replay returns the original task and audit ID and time with one total mutation; same-key different payload fails idempotency conflict; stale new requests write nothing
Corrections require an authorized actor and expected version, and audit metadata remains content-free
Every report cell traces to the five persisted responsibility fields and authorized current signals; discussion-only, evidence_missing, and needs_review facts are excluded
A four-hidden-stages-to-one-member and execution-to-another fixture uses the exact PRD concentrated-coordination template, not the shared template

Empty, balanced, and uneven fixtures remain deterministic and contain no score, rank, blame, diagnosis, or relationship judgment

update_tasks.spec: Implement a fresh care capability against CONTRACT-CORR-002 and DATA-CORR-001 without merging the rejected attempt. Read Clock.now once per command and use that reading for all deadline decisions, transition timestamps, idempotency persistence, and audits. Acknowledgement is timely only when server now is strictly before the acknowledgement deadline; equality or lateness cannot suppress escalation. Persist and audit the bounded handling resolution and retain it through closure. Enforce one PostgreSQL lock order: care events in deterministic ID order before care rules in deterministic ID order. Add a credential-free disposable PostgreSQL race test using existing locked dependencies and a care-local harness.

Start from the exact accepted FOUND-LOCK-001 SHA, which must contain accepted QA-REPAIR-001, DATA-CORR-001, and CONTRACT-CORR-002 ancestry. Merge the exact accepted remote SHAs for EXPR-REPAIR-001, CONV-REPAIR-002, RESP-REPAIR-002, HAND-001, CARE-REPAIR-001, and PRIV-REPAIR-001 with clean --no-ff merges. Never merge or cherry-pick rejected EXPR-001, CONV-001, RESP-001, CARE-001, PRIV-001, QA-001, CONV-REPAIR-001, or RESP-REPAIR-001 commit objects. Add only integration-owned actor boundaries, command/query composition, routes, database wiring, and demo documentation. Preserve Fixture and non-production truth labels.
acceptance: FOUND-LOCK-001 is the exact integration base and QA-REPAIR-001, DATA-CORR-001, and CONTRACT-CORR-002 are verified ancestors
Every non-ancestor dependency SHA is an exact second parent of a clean no-ff merge
HAND-001 remains the accepted handover implementation and is not repeated or replaced
No rejected or failed Attempt SHA is an ancestor of the integrated alpha
The seven-step Fixture flow runs through real command/query handlers and disposable PostgreSQL
Server-side authorization and pre-provider authorization remain effective
Blocked, denied, provider-failed, database-failed, care-boundary, deletion, and export paths remain explicit
Both browser viewports render the real Next.js application without regression
README and demo documentation distinguish Fixture, local runtime, public deployment, and official acceptance
